verdict.rationale: ReadMe offers linting rules, GitHub sync, and AI writer proposals, but these are triggered by manual runs or PR events for documentation maintenance, not a general-purpose 'define rules that trigger arbitrary actions on events' automation engine for AI-native users. No evidence of a rules/automation/webhook engine letting users define custom event-triggered actions. missing for 10: an event-trigger/automation rules engine, webhook or conditional action framework, evidence of user-defined triggers beyond docs linting/sync.
